statement: Lernen is 100% free for everyone forever. No subscriptions, no payments, no paywalls, no advertising, and no closed-source APIs. Built entirely on free and open-source software, datasets, and community contributions.

dataSources.name: Kaikki.org / Wiktionary
dataSources.usage: Headwords, grammatical inflection tables (declension & conjugation), definitions, genders, and parts of speech.
dataSources.attribution: Derived from German Wiktionary dumps parsed by Kaikki.org. Contributors to Wiktionary (Wiktionary.org).

dataSources.name: Tatoeba Project
dataSources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 France (CC BY 2.0 FR)
dataSources.usage: Bilingual example sentences illustrating vocabulary in authentic contexts.
dataSources.attribution: Sentence data courtesy of the Tatoeba Project and its open community of volunteer contributors.

dataSources.name: SUBTLEX-DE & Leipzig Corpora
dataSources.license: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial (CC BY-NC) / Open Academic Data
dataSources.usage: Frequency counts, frequency bands, and CEFR-mapped frequency wordlists.
dataSources.attribution: Brysbaert et al. (SUBTLEX-DE) and University of Leipzig Corpora Collection.

dataSources.name: OpenThesaurus
dataSources.license: GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL) / CC BY-SA 4.0
dataSources.usage: German synonym clusters, collocations, and associated terms.
dataSources.attribution: OpenThesaurus community project (Daniel Naber and contributors).

dataSources.name: Mozilla Common Voice & Wikimedia Commons
dataSources.usage: Spoken German audio recordings and pronunciation samples.
dataSources.attribution: Mozilla Foundation Common Voice Project & Wikimedia Commons contributors.

dataSources.name: FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler)
dataSources.usage: State-of-the-art memory retention algorithm powering the vocabulary review queue.
dataSources.attribution: Jarrett Ye and Open Spaced Repetition team.

dataSources.name: OpenDyslexic Font
dataSources.usage: Dyslexia-friendly reading font option in accessibility settings.
